name: agent-task-export
description: Local task evidence export with compact agent handoffs, indexed tool records and verification gaps.

interface.longDescription: Export observable task messages, tool calls, edits and checks into a local bundle. Read a compact handoff first and fetch evidence by ID. Requires local Python 3.10+; excludes hidden reasoning.
interface.defaultPrompt: Export this task as a compact handoff with indexed evidence and verification gaps.
